name: agy-context
description: Context insight for Antigravity, inspired by dsh-context: a side-pane dashboard (insights, context trend and browser, events, file activity, commands, subagent fleet, settings) and a /context skill showing what fills the context window, how it grows per turn, and token, cache and cost usage. Includes an isolated side-question analysis and a /btw helper.
author: Wandering233
suggestedPrompts: Analyze the context of this conversation and tell me what is taking the most space
Which turns grew the context most, and how can I slim it down?
Show my Antigravity token and cache usage over the last 7 days
